snippet.title: Theos: Cities of Myth | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Ancient Greece, Founders! 🏺

Join us today as we dive into your very first look at the gameplay of Theos: Cities of Myth, the all-new city-builder from the makers of Pharaoh: A New Era!

In today's gameplay overview, we’ll take you through the core foundations of building a legendary Polis:

⚡ The Sanctuary: Erect your divine seat of power and the central heart of your city.

⚡ Divine Favor & Wrath: Satisfy the whims of 7 Olympian Gods to unlock powerful blessings—or face their wrath.

⚡ Mastering the City: Manage supply chains, optimize citizen needs, and enjoy full control over unit pathways (no more lost walkers!).

⚡ Legends & Conquest: Attract historical figures and legendary heroes to your polis, build an all-conquering military powerhouse or a thriving trading empire.

Check out the trailer, get a taste of what’s coming, and tell us in the comments: which Olympian God will you dedicate your first Polis to? 🏛️

Wishlist Theos: Cities of Myth now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002130/Theos_Cities_Of_Myth/
---
For more updates and to join the community, follow us on social media:
